edits.before: Level 1 is a pure survival exercise — Illaoi's Test of Spirit (E) is active immediately and one successful pull turns the lane into her tentacle field while your spirit takes 15% bonus damage. Stay at max Q range, land Chain Lash for CS, and do not step into her E cast range to trade. At level 2 she gains Tentacle Smash (W) which means she can proc a tentacle slam on top of a pulled spirit — still do not commit. Your only real window before level 3 is the fifteen seconds after her E misses: if you see it sail past you, immediately dash in with E and burn your W for a burst trade, then back out before tentacles re-stack. Missing that window and standing still is what loses this lane in the first five minutes.
edits.after: Level 1 is the one level the field cannot punish you — her tentacles only swing at spirits, Vessels and victims of Harsh Lesson, and she has none of those yet. Step up, land Chain Lash for CS, and take the even trade while it exists. At level 2 Harsh Lesson arrives on a 4-second cooldown and every nearby tentacle starts swinging at whoever it hits — from here, stop committing. Your real window is the 16 seconds after Test of Spirit misses: if you see it sail past, dash in with E and burn W for a burst trade, then leave before tentacles re-stack. Missing that window and standing still is what loses this lane in the first five minutes.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 give you more sustained trade pressure via passive Petricite Burst autos and better W healing, but none of that matters if you are fighting inside an active tentacle field — Illaoi's passive heals her per tentacle hit during Cruel Tide, and that outraces your W sustain in any drawn-out exchange. Your goal is to identify when she has zero tentacles near the CS zone, then take short E2-chain-into-W burst trades and exit. At level 6 you steal Leap of Faith, which is a real power moment — but only if you use it in a controlled all-in when she has no tentacles pre-placed; copying her R into an empty lane is strong, copying it at 30% HP into three tentacles is a death sentence. Keep short trades, respect the field, and try to convert your E stun into a W kill window when you have a HP lead from prior burst trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 give you more sustained trade pressure via passive Petricite Burst autos and better W healing, but none of that matters inside an active tentacle field — every tentacle that damages you heals her, and that outraces your W sustain in any drawn-out exchange. Your goal is to spot when she has zero tentacles near the CS zone, then take short E2-chain-into-W burst trades and exit. At level 6 you steal Leap of Faith, a real power moment — but only in a controlled all-in when she has no tentacles pre-placed; copying her R into an empty lane is strong, copying it at 30% HP into three tentacles is a death sentence. Keep trades short, respect the field, and convert your E2 chain-pull into a W kill window once poke has given you the HP lead.
